But as she arrived at the hot spring, her hopes were dashed. A sign hanging at the entrance read: **Closed for Maintenance.** The sight left Mitsuri feeling defeated. She sighed in disappointment and whined, "Stupid demons! They just had to go and destroy my precious hot spring!"
